reasoning: The evidence shows significant democratic deterioration in France during 2025: repeated use of Article 49.3 to bypass parliament, multiple government collapses, historically low trust in institutions (only 22-23% trust politics/democracy), 59% with no party affiliation, and growing political paralysis. The Economist's Democracy Index measures electoral process, civil liberties, political participation, political culture, and government functioning - several of these appear compromised. The structural governance crisis, reliance on constitutional workarounds, and erosion of democratic legitimacy strongly suggest France's democracy score will decline in the 2025 report.
